🎥🎬: The Office (2005–2013)

At the Scranton branch of Dunder Mifflin, an ordinary paper company becomes the setting for an unforgettable group of coworkers. Regional manager Michael Scott desperately wants to be everyone’s friend, often creating awkward situations with his attempts to entertain and motivate the office.

Meanwhile, Jim Halpert spends his days pulling pranks on Dwight Schrute while developing a relationship with receptionist Pam Beesly. Their slow-burning romance unfolds alongside the complicated friendships, rivalries, promotions, and office romances happening around them.

As the years pass, the employees grow from a dysfunctional group of coworkers into something closer to a family. Through career changes, relationships, weddings, heartbreak, and countless workplace disasters, the documentary captures the strange, hilarious, and surprisingly heartfelt world of Dunder Mifflin.
